Subject: Next steps: Vendor onboarding & PR path for Redwood pilot

Hi Samantha / Tom —

Thanks again for walking through the pilot use case today. Quick recap and recommended next steps so procurement has what they need: 

Summary of commercial paths we discussed:
- Pilot (non-production): card payment preferred for speed (we can accept corporate card up to $25,000 for a pilot).
- Production: standard PO via Coupa or Ariba; vendor onboarding required for a vendor ID.
- Marketplace: if you want to subscribe via ClearWave's cloud marketplace (if available), let us know and we’ll surface pricing and billing flow.

Procurement asks / items we can provide now:
1) PR template (attached) your finance team can use to start an internal Purchase Requisition.
2) Vendor onboarding packet: W-9 / tax docs, COI, Redwood remit address, and vendor contact — we can attach or upload to your Coupa request.
3) Supplier ID mapping: if you’ll use Coupa/Ariba, please include the preferred supplier name (we suggest: Redwood Inference, Inc. — remit: 1234 Redwood Way, San Francisco, CA 94107) and the contact person for vendor management.

Suggested mutual action plan:
- By Mon 11/23: ClearWave to open PR (attach our template) or confirm card path for pilot.
- By Wed 11/25: Procurement posts supplier request in Coupa/Ariba (or confirms marketplace interest).
- By Fri 11/27: Redwood uploads vendor evidence to procurement portal / provides signed paperwork.

Attachments: clearwave_pr_template.xlsx (xlsx) — PR template
Reference link: Redwood vendor onboarding guide (see link below)

If helpful, I can introduce your procurement contact to Aditya (SE) and Laura (AM) on a short call to answer vendor setup questions. Next steps?

Thanks,
Hannah Schmitt
Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0142

Hi Samantha —

Happy to jump in with the procurement details. TL;DR: yes we can be onboarded as \"Redwood Inference, Inc.\" and we can accept card for the pilot with a $25k standard single-charge limit; we can accommodate $20k if you need a lower threshold — just flag that in the PR.

Vendor data you can use for Coupa/Ariba:
- Supplier name: Redwood Inference, Inc.
- Remit / billing: 1234 Redwood Way, San Francisco, CA 94107
- Tax ID / EIN: 81-2345678 (W-9 available)
- Primary vendor contact: Hannah Schmitt, hannah.schmitt@redwood.ai, +1 415-555-0142
- Email for invoices: invoices@redwood.ai

Coupa-specific tips:
- When you submit Supplier Request, include a suggested supplier ID string (e.g., REDWOOD-INF-001) to speed matching.
- Attach the vendor packet (W-9, COI, standard SOW) as a single PDF. We included a combined vendor_kb link (attached as a text file with upload instructions).
- If you choose Marketplace, note that marketplace billing will route through your marketplace provider and pricing may vary; choose this only if you want the marketplace procurement flow.

Ive attached a short mapping of the fields Coupa expects (supplier name, remit address, tax id, contact, default cost center) and a sample supplier_id mapping that Finance uses on the vendor side. Happy to hop on a 15-minute screen share to complete the supplier submission in real time.

Regards,
Aditya Rao
